summary: During the 2.4 to 2.6 upgrade users, teams, organizations, memberships and common roles move from controller to the platform gateway, and controller admins become gateway admins; more objects mean a longer upgrade, about two hours for 4,000 users, 400 teams and 40 organizations. Some APIs are deprecated in 2.6 and RBAC is unified across components.
questions: How long does the AAP 2.4 to 2.6 upgrade take?
Do controller admins stay admins after upgrading to 2.6?
Are teams and organizations migrated in the 2.6 upgrade?
Are any APIs deprecated in AAP 2.6?
